stem.en: Car A starts from rest and moves with a constant acceleration. Its velocity reaches 5 m/s in 5 s. What is its displacement in those 5 s, in m?

explanation.en: The velocity-time graph is a straight line from 0 m/s at 0 s to 5 m/s at 5 s. The area under it is a triangle: 1/2 x 5 s x 5 m/s = 12.5 m.

hints.en: Draw the velocity-time graph. What shape is the area under it?
